messages.content: Alaska changed our November 13 return from San Diego. The new time is almost four hours earlier, and I don't want to accept it without comparing the alternatives.

The protected outbound on November 8 and the five-night Wayfarer reservation are unchanged. For November 13, Alaska offers: keep the changed nonstop departing SAN at 1:05 p.m. and arriving MSP at 6:42 p.m.; switch at no added fare to a nonstop leaving at 5:00 p.m. and arriving at 10:37 p.m.; or take a 6:25 p.m. departure connecting in Seattle and reaching MSP at 12:48 a.m. on November 14.
How much usable time do we lose with the 1:05 compared with the 5:00? Assume we need to be at SAN two hours ahead.

The 1:05 flight means reaching SAN by 11:05 a.m., so you would likely leave the hotel around 10:40 a.m. The 5:00 nonstop moves that to a 3:00 p.m. airport arrival and roughly a 2:35 p.m. hotel departure. That preserves just under four hours in San Diego and still gets you home the same night.
And the one-stop isn't buying us much beyond that, right?

Correct. It adds about 85 minutes in San Diego versus the 5:00 nonstop, but includes a Seattle connection and lands after midnight. With deplaning and the ride home, you would probably reach home around 1:30-2:00 a.m., compared with roughly 11:15-11:40 p.m. on the evening nonstop.
What happens with checkout and the airport ride we already arranged?

The November 13 checkout date remains correct for every option. The hotel has standard 11:00 a.m. checkout, so luggage would need to be stored after checkout for either evening itinerary. Your airport ride is set for 2:35 p.m., matching the 5:00 nonstop; keeping the 1:05 flight would require moving it to about 10:40 a.m., while the one-stop would require a pickup around 4:00 p.m.
Take the 5:00 nonstop. No reason to give up the afternoon or arrive after midnight. Please confirm it and update the itinerary.

The return has been exchanged at no additional fare to the November 13 Alaska nonstop departing San Diego at 5:00 p.m. and arriving in Minneapolis at 10:37 p.m. Both travelers remain ticketed, the November 8 outbound and shared checked bag are unchanged, and the Wayfarer stay still ends November 13. The 2:35 p.m. airport ride remains aligned, so no ground-transport change is needed. The updated itinerary has been issued.
